subject: Make-good credit request after deployment freeze / demo reschedule
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@papertrail.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Integrio Engineering <integrio-devs@integrio.ai>, Nadia Romero <nadia@integrio.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot kickoff / deployment freeze - need runway

Hi Vivek,

Quick update from our side: yesterday's deploy to staging hit a datastore migration deadlock; our engineers had to roll back and we've paused all demo prep until we get a clean CI green. That pushes our planned demo window (Apr 1) to at least Apr 6.

We're close to a fix but QA uncovered one more edge case around session tokens. Can we ask Redwood for a short safety-net — a make-good credit and a 7 day extension on the sandbox/pilot window? Without it, we'll run out of provisioned tokens before product team sign-off.

Attaching the most recent error dump and a screenshot of the demo calendar. Appreciate any help.

Attachments: deployment-error-log-20270327.txt (text), demo-schedule-screenshot-20270328.png (image)

Thanks,
Samir
VP Product 
PaperTrail / integrio pilot

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@papertrail.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff / deployment freeze - need runway

Samir —

Sorry to hear about the rollback. We're definitely willing to help bridge this. To get this moving quickly I need two things: (1) a short summary of the token consumption estimate for the new demo window (how many tokens you expect to burn over the extended period), and (2) confirmation that the issue is isolated to staging and there's no PII/regulatory exposure.

I'll flag this with Marissa for provisional approval of a make-good credit (we typically do a one-time safety-net for pilots with deployment hiccups). If Karthik's engineering team needs a temporary capacity bump we can also provide a short burst at reduced cost.

If you can send the token estimate today we should have an answer by EOD tomorrow.

— Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Integrio Engineering <integrio-devs@integrio.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@papertrail.ai>
Cc: Nadia Romero <nadia@integrio.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff / deployment freeze - need runway

Vivek / Samir —

Quick technical note (so you have numbers): our QA lead estimates ~4.5M tokens of additional test traffic to complete end-to-end validation and two dry-run demos. If we push the demo to Apr 6 that number is likely accurate; if we end up needing another smoke cycle it could hit ~6M. The failure is a migration ordering race in our staging DB — isolated and non-prod. No customer data or PII exposure.

We can reduce token burn by cutting the demo dataset to the top 10% of sessions, which would bring it down to ~2M tokens, but the product team prefers a full run for execs.

— Integrio Eng (Nadia)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff / deployment freeze - need runway

Looping in Marissa for approval. My quick read: given the numbers (4.5M baseline) and this being clearly a non-prod rollback, I recommend we offer a two-part remedy: (A) a one-time promo credit covering up to 5M tokens as a make-good, and (B) a temporary 7-day extension on the sandbox window. Finance and Billing will need a short note but I think we can handle this as an AE-level concession with Marissa's sign-off.

If Marissa prefers a smaller cap we can also do a tiered grant: 2M guaranteed + review after one week.

Also note: if they take the reduced-demo option (2M) we should propose that as part of the offer to conserve credits.

— Karthik
Sr Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@papertrail.ai>
Cc: Billing <billing@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff / deployment freeze - need runway

Thanks team — approved.

Marissa approves a provisional make-good promo: up to 5,000,000 tokens credited to PaperTrail's pilot account (Deal DEAL-4826). We'll also extend the sandbox/pilot window by 7 calendar days from the current end date (new end date: 2027-04-13). Billing, please create a promo code/adjustment referencing HubSpot deal 4826 and mark as "pilot make-good - deployment rollback".

Samir — please confirm whether you want the full run (we'll grant the 5M cap) or prefer the reduced top-10% demo (we'll apply only what you use). If you choose the reduced demo we can close this with a 2M cap instead; either way we can get the promo applied within one business day.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
